Name: Home of Abandoned Mods - CFR Conversions
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: A hub for ONLY unofficial ports of Custom Farming Redux packs
Description:
#NOTICE: CFR is now deprecated by Producer Framework Mod, though these packs should still function

**This page is ONLY for CFR packs.  Places for other conversions/updates listed below.
**[SMAPI 1.3 Requests](https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/updating-mods-for-stardew-valley-1-3.142524) 
[Content Patcher Requests
](https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/migrating-xnb-mods-to-content-patcher-packs.141577/)[PPJA Home of Abandoned Mods - Json Assets Conversions](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3374)﻿

DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT NEXUSMODS, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

[Custom Farming Redux](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991)﻿ is a companion mod for Json Assets, providing the framework for new machines to be added to the game.  See the mod page for example packs and some documentation.

![](https://i.imgur.com/syytYWb.png)﻿

Each download is separate, pick accordingly.

[Nightmare Scarecrows](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2998/)﻿ by [MelNoelle](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/58329826)﻿ - conversion by [Dragonwrath](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/1195630)﻿
[The Pumpkin King](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3006)﻿ by [Kirbster87](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/26588659)﻿ - conversion by [minervamaga](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/51777556)﻿
[Owl Scarecrows](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/936)﻿ by [Ankokou](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/33928290)﻿ - conversion by [Geminia](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/52098691)﻿ (permission granted by Ankokou)
[Kitty Scarecrows](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/191)﻿ by [jinxiewinxie ](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/8386684)﻿- conversion by [minervamaga ](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/51777556)﻿(permission granted by jinxie)
[Halloween Scarecrows](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2892)﻿ by [exhaustedsunflower ](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48319933)﻿- conversion by [Geminia ](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/52098691)﻿(permission granted by exhaustedsunflower)
<s>[Perfume Maker](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3005)﻿ by [clark ](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53822141)﻿- conversion by [minervamaga](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/51777556)﻿</s> Now officially updated!
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/936[Ikebana](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2034)﻿ by https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/33928290[Esilabet](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/52457016)﻿ - conversion by [Geminia](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/52098691)﻿

![](https://i.imgur.com/LKwk9jp.png)

- This mod is fully demonetized and serves as an unofficial conversion until either the original creator would like this taken down or the original creator uploads their own version. This mod also serves as example packs for the CFR official documentation.
- If you are one of the original creators please DM me and I will send you the converted file and remove it from this hub as soon as possible.

![](https://i.imgur.com/Eqdpuvd.png)

- Latest version of [Custom Farming Redux](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991)﻿
- Latest version of [PyTK](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726/)﻿
- Latest version of [SMAPI
](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI)-Any other required mods listed for each pack

![](https://i.imgur.com/kLbxt2U.png)

- Drag + Drop the unzipped folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder

![](https://i.imgur.com/MnkF0nq.png)﻿

- Delete every existing item made from this mod
- Remove the corresponding folder(s) inside /Mods

If you miss any (especially in your inventory) you can crash your game.
